text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
we decided to take the train home today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ufu, Onii-chan.
Today's outing was really fun too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ufu, Onee-chan.
Today's outing was really fun too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tinkle-tinkle-ting~♪)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like the train is coming.
Let's get in line.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay, there's open seats!
Curren's gonna sit on the edgeâª

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Of course big brother is right next to me, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Of course big sister is right next to me, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And you get to talk lots and lots with Curren♪
Come on, hurry, hurry~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click-clack, click-clack... click-clack, click-clack...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for taking me out to have funâª
Curren took a ton of photos too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Besides selfies, look! Candid shots of Big Brother~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Besides selfies, look! Candid shots of Big Sister~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I wonder when that happened~?
Maybe I should post it on Umastagram?
...Just kidding~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And for a while, I sat beside Curren Chan as she kept showing me her smartphone screen, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click-clack, click-clack... click-clack, click-clack...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...*snooze*... *snooze*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan is breathing softly in her sleep.
...I could feel her warmth radiating through my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh... Big Bro...
*snooze*... *snooze*...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh... Big Sis...
*snooze*... *snooze*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click-clack, click-clack... click-clack, click-clack...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Big bro... ther...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Big sis... ter...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That part of you... I really... love it...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... That felt so nice~...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, Onii-chan, your shoulder
was super comfy to sleep on.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, Onee-chan, your shoulder
was super comfy to sleep on.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"So next time I take the train,
I'll make sure to book my seat in advance♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep, reserving the spot next to Big Brother!
You're not allowed to give it away to anyone else, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep, reserving the spot next to Big Sister!
You're not allowed to give it away to anyone else, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on the way home that day,
I walked side by side with Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Standing just a little closer than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...I decided to wake Curren Chan up gently."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mnyaa... Ehehe~ Morning, Big Brother~
Did you still wanna chat with Curren~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mnyaa... Ehehe~ Morning, Big Sister~
Did you still wanna chat with Curren~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Guess it can't be helped... Wonder if there's any videos I haven't shown you yet? ...Ah."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone on Umastagram! Look at this outfit!
Curren is actually enrolling at Tracen Academy♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm super excited and my heart's racing already!
Both for the friends I'll make at the academy, and for the races!

text_block_list.name: Car
text_block_list.text: (Pfft!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Looks like my limo is here!
Well, I'm off then.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —To go meet Curren's fated person!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha. This video brings back memories.
Didn't it get like a million Umalikes?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...It's a precious memory, so
maybe I'll move it to my favorites folder♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Psssssh...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like we're already there.
That's all for today, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like we're already there.
That's all for today, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Neither of us forgot anything, right?
Well then..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, oopsie! Curren almost forgot!
Big Bro, over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, oopsie! Curren almost forgot!
Big Sis, over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, got a new photo~♪
I'll make this one a "Favorite" too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan headed toward the ticket gate
with light, springy steps.
